item.title: Editorial
item.description: We devote this eighteenth issue of Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros’ (CCS’) on-line magazine to review some current topics that we deem relevant for the insurance industry.

item.title: Digital applications: use in natural disaster management
item.description: New technologies are entering our daily lives every year. The use of these technologies has crystallised as a form of change that has turned society on its head in just a short span of time and will continue to do so.

item.title: Importance of computational modelling and risk forecasting in cardiovascular disease prevention to reduce morbidity, mortality, and health insurance claim rates
item.description: The different forms of computational science, whether descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, prescriptive, or preventive, are helpful in creating predictive models based on regression techniques.
